description: Pre-trade GO / HOLD / BLOCK gate for a Base ERC-20 swap: honeypot/sellability + admin-control checks + Uniswap v3 liquidity vs. your trade size. Returns the GO/HOLD/BLOCK decision AND decision-grade sizing — per $100 / $1k / $10k / $50k (and your exact notional_usd): entry-slippage + exit-simulation (net USD recovered vs lost to slippage), round-trip breakeven move %, and max_safe_notional_usd. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via the shared MCP payment gate (the direct HTTP endpoint GET /gate/swap is $0.008 — MCP tools/call is gated at a flat $0.005 per request).
